periods.totalSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(paid_amount_cents),0)::text AS total FROM business.orders WHERE dataset_version=$1 AND store_id=$2 AND region_id='east' AND payment_status='succeeded' AND paid_at >= $3 AND paid_at < $4
periods.skuSql: SELECT i.sku_id,sum(i.paid_amount_cents)::text AS total FROM business.order_items i JOIN business.orders o USING(dataset_version,store_id,order_id) WHERE o.dataset_version=$1 AND o.store_id=$2 AND o.region_id='east' AND o.payment_status='succeeded' AND o.paid_at >= $3 AND o.paid_at < $4 GROUP BY i.sku_id ORDER BY i.sku_id
